entity.current_state: Link behavior is scope-dependent: targeted inactive links no longer work after the 2025 boundary, while other goo.gl links continue functioning.
known_unknowns: Whether a particular goo.gl URL is disabled depends on the link-specific activity/deactivation condition described by Google.
entity.notes: Corrects the older display assumption that all goo.gl links would stop working.
entity.still_usable_note: Google revised its earlier universal shutdown plan: only links that showed no activity in late 2024 and received the deactivation interstitial were targeted for deactivation after August 25, 2025; other goo.gl links continue to function.
entity.summary: Google no longer treats all goo.gl links as universally shutting down. A defined inactive subset was targeted for deactivation, while other existing goo.gl links remain supported.

events.migration_path: Migrate any link that displays Google's deactivation warning to another URL before relying on it after the stated boundary.
events.notes: This event records the scope correction, not universal removal.
events.summary: Google revised its earlier plan to discontinue all goo.gl URLs and limited deactivation to links that had shown no activity in late 2024 and had received the deactivation warning interstitial.
events.title: Google narrows planned goo.gl deactivation scope
events.user_impact: Only the targeted inactive-link subset is deactivated; other goo.gl links continue functioning, so universal removal must not be inferred.

evidence.notes: Primary evidence for the narrowed deactivation scope.
evidence.quote_or_summary: Google's August 1, 2025 update says it reversed the plan to discontinue all goo.gl URLs: only a specific inactive subset would be deactivated after August 25, while other goo.gl links would continue to function.
evidence.title: Google URL Shortener links will no longer be available [updated]
